In this case it is called the conditionnel journalistique, seen from time to time in the press or heard on news broadcasts. La reine de Suède se rendrait en The Queen of Sweden is reportedly goin Australie la semaine prochaine. to Australia next week. Son beau-frère serait impliqué dans His (her) brother-in-law is allegedly une affaire de fraude fiscale. involved in tax fraud.
